# Manifest reference

Every key `plugin.toml` accepts, from the types the loader actually uses.
The prose, and the reasoning, are in [PLUGINS.md](../PLUGINS.md) §2; this
is the list.

A machine-readable copy is [`plugin-toml.schema.json`](plugin-toml.schema.json).
Point your editor at it and the manifest is checked as you type.

## The file

| Key | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `api` | number | yes | Manifest schema version. The core supports this one and the one before it; see `docs/VERSIONING.md`. |
| `deps` | [Deps](#deps) |  | How "Add package" adds a dependency. |
| `helper` | [OneOrMany_Helper](#oneormany-helper) |  | A long-lived process that runs playgrounds and answers hooks. |
| `kind` | array of [Kind](#kind) |  | The shapes a playground can take. Exactly one is the default. |
| `language` | [Language](#language) | yes | Who the language is: its id, name and file extension. |
| `lsp` | [OneOrMany_Lsp](#oneormany-lsp) |  | The language server, if the language has one. |
| `output` | [Output](#output) |  | How to find a file and line in the output, so an error is clickable. |
| `run` | [OneOrMany_Run](#oneormany-run) |  | How to run one playground. Required unless a `helper` runs them. |
| `scaffold` | [Scaffold](#scaffold) |  | Files written into every new playground besides the main one. |
| `toolchain` | [Toolchain](#toolchain) | yes | How to tell the language is installed, and what to say when it isn't. |

## AcquireFile

One platform's download.

| Key | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `arch` | [Arch](#arch) | yes |  |
| `member` | any |  | What to take out of the archive. Absent when the download is the tool itself rather than an archive of one. |
| `os` | [Os](#os) | yes |  |
| `rename_to` | any |  | What to call it once it is out, when that isn't the member's own name. |
| `sha256` | string | yes | Hex SHA-256 of the file at `url`, checked before anything is unpacked. |
| `url` | string | yes |  |

## Language

| Key | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `extension` | string | yes | Playground files are `main.<extension>`. |
| `highlighter` | any |  |  |
| `id` | string | yes | Stable, lowercase, `[a-z0-9-]`. Names the plugin folder. |
| `main_path` | any |  | Where the main file lives inside a playground. Defaults to `main.<extension>`. |
| `name` | string | yes | Shown in menus and the status bar. |
| `version` | any |  | The plugin's own version, for the plugins panel and `plugin list` (work item 05-02). Optional, and never interpreted: `api` is the compatibility contract, not this. |

## Lsp

| Key | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `acquire` | [Acquire](#acquire) |  | How to get the server, when it isn't installed (work item 04-08a). |
| `args` | array of string |  |  |
| `command` | string | yes |  |
| `env` | table |  |  |
| `from_helper` | boolean |  | The server is part of this plugin's helper: `[helper.build]` runs before it starts, the same way it does before a run (work item 04-13). |
| `idle_shutdown` | any |  |  |
| `init_options` | any |  |  |
| `os` | any |  |  |
| `register` | [Register](#register) |  |  |
| `workspace` | [Workspace](#workspace) |  |  |
| `workspace_acquire` | [Acquire](#acquire) |  | How to put it there. Runs in the workspace root. |
| `workspace_files` | array of [ScaffoldFile](#scaffoldfile) |  | Files the server's workspace needs, written there once: a `tsconfig.json` for a server that insists on one. |
| `workspace_needs` | any |  | A path inside the workspace the server needs to find there, such as `node_modules/typescript` (work item 04-08b). |
